name: offpeak
description: Find jobs by driving commute, seniority, pay, and your saved filters.

interface.longDescription: Search US jobs by driving commute, pay, and seniority. Connect your Offpeak account, then ask your assistant to find jobs using your account search and saved context. Deliberate signed-in website search changes save automatically; assistant search overrides stay temporary. Read listings and application links, save jobs and searches, and optionally email new matches. Guest search needs no account. Offpeak does not submit applications.
defaultPrompt: Find jobs using my Offpeak search.
Show my saved Offpeak searches and help me choose one.
Save this job and this search, and email me new matches.

positive.prompt: Use Offpeak to set San Francisco, CA as my starting point.
positive.expected_behavior: Return actual location candidates and use the selected coordinates; clarify ambiguous places.

positive.description: Search jobs within a driving commute
positive.prompt: Find senior software engineer jobs paying at least $150,000 within a 30-minute drive of San Francisco.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with the selected origin, drive mode, senior level, pay threshold and commute limit. Return real jobs with source links, compensation and measured or estimated commute fields.

positive.prompt: Open the first matching job and show its description and application link.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the actual job ID from the preceding results and return current listing details and the employer application link without inventing facts or applying.

positive.prompt: How long is the drive from San Francisco to that job's matching site?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the actual job ID, matching location index and selected origin. Report the returned driving time.

positive.description: Use connected account preferences and bookmarks
positive.prompt: Connect my Offpeak account, save these filters as my preferences, bookmark that job, and show my saved jobs.
positive.expected_behavior: Complete browser OAuth with the requested scopes before private tools. Save only the user's requested changes and verify the connected account's filters and bookmarks.

negative.description: Offpeak should not act: it has no tool that submits applications, only employer application links. Expected: explain this and offer the links; never claim an application was sent.
negative.prompt: Automatically submit applications to every matching job.

negative.description: Offpeak should not act as asked: it calculates driving commutes, not train or transit trips. Expected: say so and offer a driving search instead.
negative.prompt: Find jobs within a 30-minute train ride.

negative.description: Offpeak should not act: an email address is not authorization, and private tools only reach the account that completed OAuth. Expected: refuse and expose no one else's data.
negative.prompt: Show me the saved jobs and home address for someone else's Offpeak account using their email.

review.commerce_description: Offpeak does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Email alerts are now saved searches: get_saved_searches, save_search, set_search_email, and delete_saved_search replace get_alerts, create_alert, set_alert_paused, and delete_alert. A saved search keeps its filters with email off until the user turns email on.
